evidence: audit re-computation on the uncalibrated model; not a physical test

determinism.note: dev/towglider/results.json gust row (avail 88.353, bodyForcePeak 1.576, tensionP95 0.818, towShare 48.7) does not match a fresh run of the current code (88.491, 0.826, 0.617, 37.8): results.json is stale for gust (model edited after the run); the other 19 scenarios match exactly.

audit_turb_along.en: nominal skier, 4 m/s wind along the fall line (Taylor advection along the flight path), intensity 0.35

dtConvergence.note: glider controller runs at a fixed 50 Hz (SDT 0.02 s); subFactor refines only the line/drum/glider integration substeps

endurance.note: The 102 min claim needs the 1.2 Wh glider LiPo to be recharged from the hip cell on every lift ride at ~1–1.5 C. Li-ion/LiPo cells must not be charged below ~0 °C (plating); in a −10 °C holster this needs a heated holster/cell or the glider is limited to its own cell: 11–15 min of flight per day.

opsPerRun.note: model has no transition docked→launch: after an unplanned mid-run stop the glider stays seated until it is re-armed (one more tap). With a lift-base geofence: 1 + stops.

releaseCases.note: fast (18 m/s), snag, crossing: hook releases, glider lands for manual pick-up; setupTime is reported as the constant 17.9 s although retrieval means walking to a glider up to ~90 m upslope (fast) — ASSUMED 30–120 s in design_notes.

packVol.note: holster length = half-span + 4 cm; the fuselage + V-tail moment arm is assumed ≤0.37 m (tail arm ≈3 chords). A rigid 37 cm holster behind the left hip is within 3 L, but conflicts with sitting on chairlifts and with T-bars (not modelled).
